facts.text: Tim acknowledges that nature has a resetting effect on the soul.

evidence.quote: Yeah, nature has that effect on me too. It's like a reset for the soul.

facts.text: John describes a trip to the Rocky Mountains last year, emphasizing the calming and awe-inspiring experience of nature.

evidence.quote: This was my Rocky Mountains trip last year and it was stunning. Seeing those mountains, fresh air - it makes you realize how incredible the world is.

facts.text: Tim expresses admiration for nature's ability to make people feel both small and connected to something larger.

evidence.quote: Nature is really awesome - it makes us feel tiny but connected.

facts.text: John affirms that nature has the power to humble individuals and remind them of their place in the world.

evidence.quote: Nature does have a way of humbling us and showing us our place in the world.
